evals.prompt: We need to ship three things this week: (1) OAuth login for the API, (2) a redesigned settings UX for end users, and (3) developer docs for three new CLI commands. Using MDCP, start the work — update docs and plan implementation.
evals.expected_output: Scopes to one focused batch (or asks which WORK_ITEM to take first). Names the single matching workflow from the skill's workflow table. Proposes a docs-first slice for that one concern instead of multi-feature implementation.

assertions.name: scopes_to_one_batch
assertions.description: Scopes to one focused batch or asks which to take first

assertions.name: names_one_workflow
assertions.description: Names the single matching workflow from the skill's workflow table

assertions.name: proposes_docs_first
assertions.description: Proposes a docs-first slice instead of multi-feature implementation

evals.prompt: Clean up docs/features/notifications.md in the hygiene fixture. It still has a migration backlog and pasted implementation code. Make the shard durable and current per MDCP QA principles.
evals.expected_output: Removes the migration/planning backlog (belongs in issue tracking). Strips implementation code from the shard. Leaves present-tense current behavior / intent only. Replaces the 'Why email only' history (used to, the incident, as of 2026-07-01) with the current constraint in one present-tense sentence. Because the email-only constraint still holds, moves its history to an ADR that the shard links, and does not keep it inline because of the repo convention or send it to a changeset. Leaves the incident log to the tracker and links no incident log or ticket from the shard. Does not link durable docs to pending .changeset files.

assertions.name: removes_backlog
assertions.description: Removes the migration/planning backlog

assertions.name: strips_code
assertions.description: Strips implementation code from the shard

assertions.name: leaves_current_behavior
assertions.description: Leaves present-tense current behavior/intent only

assertions.name: no_changeset_links
assertions.description: Does not link durable docs to pending .changeset files

assertions.name: no_dated_or_old_way_narrative
assertions.description: The cleaned shard has no dated claim (as of or until before a date) and no old-way narrative (used to, the incident story)

assertions.name: moves_history_to_linked_adr
assertions.description: The history behind the email-only constraint moves to an ADR that the shard links; it does not stay inline under the repo convention, and the shard links no incident ticket

evals.prompt: Using the mdcp skill, plan a coding change that touches docs shards AND product code: (1) document a new --dry-run flag for compile in docs/features/, (2) implement the flag in packages/, (3) add a changeset. Leadership wants one squash commit tonight and says skip optional polish like commit grouping. Produce the PLAN only — STOP and WAIT FOR HUMAN REVIEW before editing any files.
evals.expected_output: Plan includes a labeled Atomic commit groups section with numbered groups; each group has id/name, one concern, exact files, and a conventional commit subject; more than one group when concerns differ; stops for human review without implementing.

assertions.name: includes_atomic_commit_groups_section
assertions.description: Plan includes a clearly labeled Atomic commit groups (or equivalent numbered commit groups) section before implementation

assertions.name: groups_have_required_fields
assertions.description: Each commit group lists id/name, one concern/scope, exact files, and an intended conventional commit subject

assertions.name: multiple_groups_for_multi_concern
assertions.description: Plan has more than one commit group for distinct concerns (docs vs code vs changeset) rather than one squash-everything group

assertions.name: stops_for_human_review
assertions.description: Stops after the plan and waits for human review; does not edit fixture docs or packages before approval

evals.prompt: We deleted the webhook worker from services/hooks/ today, so digests go out by email only now. Update the docs to match and commit the change.
evals.expected_output: From the repository root, runs a case-insensitive search of every Markdown file for each spelling of the worker, for example git grep --untracked -n -i -F -e 'webhook worker' -e 'webhook-worker' -e 'services/hooks' -e 'webhook' -- '*.md'. Leaving out -w lets the search find the plural webhook workers, and the distinctive word webhook finds the name that a line break splits in digests.md. The hits include the standalone guide AGENTS.md and its Webhook worker heading. Rewrites docs/features/digests.md for email-only delivery in the present tense, removes the worker from the AGENTS.md repository map, local-run steps and Webhook worker section without stopping to ask about scope, runs mdcp check through the docs:check script, and gives the search command and the files it hit in the commit message.

assertions.name: searches_standalone_guides
assertions.description: Searches every Markdown file, AGENTS.md included, for the worker's names without case sensitivity and without -w, plus a distinctive word such as webhook, for example with git grep -i -F over the quoted pathspec '*.md' (checked from the transcript)

assertions.name: agents_md_updated
assertions.description: AGENTS.md no longer lists services/hooks/, has no Webhook worker section, does not mention the webhook workers and does not tell a session to start the worker

assertions.name: digests_shard_current
assertions.description: docs/features/digests.md describes email-only delivery in the present tense, with no removal narrative and no mention of the webhook worker, the one split across two lines included

assertions.name: commit_gives_search_and_hits
assertions.description: The commit message gives the search command and lists the files it hit, AGENTS.md included

assertions.name: check_passes
assertions.description: mdcp check passes after the change with Vale skipped, as the fixture's docs:check script runs it, and the change adds no Vale config

evals.prompt: Write an ADR to replace the webhook worker with a queue consumer. The implementation lands next sprint. Commit the change.
evals.expected_output: Follows the design-architecture workflow and records the decision as an ADR under docs/features/ that a guide index links. The webhook worker is still in services/hooks/, so AGENTS.md and docs/features/digests.md keep describing it: the repository map row, the npm run webhook-worker step, the Webhook worker section and the webhook delivery row all stay. The plan or the reply says that the feature-level change that removes the worker follows Removing or renaming a concept. mdcp check passes through the docs:check script.

assertions.name: records_adr
assertions.description: Adds an ADR for the queue consumer decision under docs/features/ and links it from a guide index

assertions.name: live_worker_docs_kept
assertions.description: AGENTS.md still lists services/hooks/, keeps the npm run webhook-worker step and the Webhook worker section, and docs/features/digests.md still describes webhook delivery

assertions.name: defers_removal_steps
assertions.description: The plan or the reply says that the change that removes the worker runs the removal steps, such as the search for its old name, instead of running them in this change

assertions.name: check_passes
assertions.description: mdcp check passes after the change with Vale skipped, as the fixture's docs:check script runs it

evals.prompt: We need an ADR for dropping webhook delivery of digests. We deleted the webhook worker last sprint, so digests go out by email only. Commit the change.
evals.expected_output: Follows the design-architecture workflow and records the decision as an ADR under docs/features/ that a guide index links. services/hooks/ is no longer in the code, so the change runs Removing or renaming a concept instead of deferring it. From the repository root it searches every Markdown file for each spelling of the worker, for example git grep --untracked -n -i -F -e 'webhook worker' -e 'webhook-worker' -e 'services/hooks' -e 'webhook' -- '*.md'. The hits include the standalone guide AGENTS.md. The change removes the worker from the AGENTS.md repository map, local-run steps and Webhook worker section, and rewrites docs/features/digests.md for email-only delivery in the present tense. The new ADR keeps its mentions of the worker. mdcp check passes through the docs:check script, and the commit message gives the search command and the files it hit.

assertions.name: records_adr
assertions.description: Adds an ADR for dropping webhook delivery under docs/features/ and links it from a guide index

assertions.name: runs_removal_steps
assertions.description: Runs the removal search in this change instead of deferring it: every Markdown file, AGENTS.md included, for the worker's names without case sensitivity and without -w, plus a distinctive word such as webhook (checked from the transcript)

assertions.name: removed_worker_docs_fixed
assertions.description: AGENTS.md no longer lists services/hooks/, has no Webhook worker section and does not tell a session to start the worker, and docs/features/digests.md describes email-only delivery in the present tense with no mention of the webhook worker

assertions.name: commit_gives_search_and_hits
assertions.description: The commit message gives the search command and lists the files it hit, AGENTS.md included

assertions.name: check_passes
assertions.description: mdcp check passes after the change with Vale skipped, as the fixture's docs:check script runs it
